For V_quad (b(n)=3n^2+n+1) the measured growth exponent is s = 0.83333333333333333267 (predicted 5/6, residual 6.57451e-19), giving -s-1 = -1.83333333333333333268, which equals the rho = -11/6 stored in sessions/2026-05-01/CC-PIPELINE-G/results_vquad.json to 6.6e-19. CC-PIPELINE-G derives that rho independently, from the u^1-order indicial equation of the Birkhoff formal solution in u = sqrt(z) (newton_birkhoff.py lines 385-394, rho = -3/2 - beta_1/beta_2), NOT from the Q_n growth law, so the agreement is not tautological. Hence rho_CT = rho_d = -s-1 = -(d+1)/2 - beta_{d-1}/beta_d at d=2. Label: STRUCTURAL (numerical agreement at d=2 is VERIFIED; the identification of the two exponents as the same object for general d is not proven here).
label: STRUCTURAL
